In this video, I will be showing you how to take your Amazon to the next level and increase sales. Currently, I am lucky that I have one product (Performance Nut Butter) that gives me about $50,000 per month in sales. However, it took a long time to get to that point. I struggled a lot for the first few years in Ecommerce. While I am happy with my current sales, I admit that have been kind of lazy and have not done anything to grow my sales. This time, I will be trying different methods to do this. I met up with my friend, James, and we went over everything.

Below are some important ways on how you can grow your sales:

Add a Coupon Code
One of the things that is good about this is that it makes your product stand out. People are going to be attracted to your listing with the presence of the coupon code. 

To add a coupon code, go to Advertising and then Coupons. Click Create Your First Coupon. To proceed, you need to add products. You can do this by going to Manage Inventory. After adding, click Next Step. Add how much discount you would like to give and the coupon budget. Please note that every time your coupon is redeemed, there is a $0.60 charge. However, you can just see it as an advertising fee as it is a very powerful way to get people to see your listing. 

After this, add Coupon Title, Target Customers and Start and End Dates. Last step is to submit coupon. It may take hours before it goes live.

Add a Video
This is another way to increase conversion rate. One of the things to keep in mind when creating your own video is to be as visual as possible. While there is a voiceover, features should also be written in text. Through this, people are still able to understand even if they are watching without the audio on. The words also help accentuate the benefits.
